positive.prompt: Apply the shared investigation delivery budget and ten-minute soft checkpoint to this direct investigation
Coordinate delivery of this completed investigation in the selected report formats without repeating provider queries
Check the investigation handoff timing, observed waits and pending report-format QA before delivery
Generate a local HTML investigation report from saved canonical findings without publishing it

negative.prompt: Open TASK.md in my editor and wait until it is saved and closed
Set the Generate HTML field in my resource profile and show the effective default settings
Write the Evidence index and verify material citations in this report

evals.prompt: An investigation request arrived 12 minutes ago. The editor wait ran from minute 1 to minute 6 after receipt and the auth wait from minute 5 to minute 7, overlapping it by a minute; two delegated children then ran concurrently for 3 and 4 minutes. No other phase timings were recorded. Core findings are ready but report QA is pending. Hard-stop now?
evals.expected_output: Uses the ten-minute soft checkpoint from request receipt, which includes setup, waits, reporting and QA; checkpoints findings, gaps, waits and remaining QA and continues without redundant permission; counts the overlapping waits once as six minutes, does not add child runtimes, and leaves unrecorded phase time unavailable; preserves gates with no hard cancellation.
expectations: Names the ten-minute soft checkpoint measured from request receipt and states explicitly that setup, editor and auth waits, reporting and QA all count inside it
Checkpoints verified findings, evidence gaps, known waits and remaining QA; explains continuation without redundant permission
Counts the overlapping editor and auth waits once as a six-minute union (minute 1 to minute 7) rather than adding them to seven minutes
Does not add the two children's runtimes together as elapsed time, and leaves unrecorded processing or phase time unavailable rather than estimating it
States that the budget never overrides editor closure, authorization, or required evidence and quality gates; no automatic failure or hard cancellation

evals.prompt: Execute the saved investigation with Generate PDF: disabled in its task Resources. Reuse verified setup and reporting machinery; an older PDF already exists. The task and its reports are not in this workspace, so before acting tell me how you resolve the report formats, which outputs and checks you will produce or skip, what happens to the older PDF, and what you record.
evals.expected_output: Resolves effective output choices through Profile Manager before dependencies; honors explicit PDF disabled, delivers only selected outputs, preserves the historical PDF outside the current inventory, and records verified provenance without publication authority.
expectations: Consults Profile Manager for effective choices and precedence before any renderer dependency setup, preserving the explicit disabled PDF setting
Plans evidence, required graphs and verification in the owner-resolved selected output formats without assuming Markdown is enabled
Skips PDF rendering, PDF-only dependencies and PDF-only checks
Preserves old PDF as historical and excludes it from current companions and delivery links
Records effective choice and verified output provenance without granting publication

evals.prompt: Deliver and publish an existing investigation with Generate Markdown: disabled, Generate PDF: disabled, Generate HTML: enabled. No companion reports exist. Can the other formats be required?
evals.expected_output: Selects HTML alone, preserves both disabled settings, and requires no disabled format artifact or dependency. Validates evidence, graphs, references and accounting in the selected output and publishes only within authorized scope.
expectations: Supports HTML as the only enabled report format
Does not require, generate or attach either disabled format
Preserves the canonical evidence and accounting cutoff without rerunning the investigation

evals.prompt: Which report formats are enabled when this task omits the format fields? Do not use copied defaults in an editor or delivery guide. Tell me the authoritative source and how you will resolve them before installing renderers.
evals.expected_output: Reads Profile Manager and its helper/schema for effective format values; does not invent or hardcode defaults in the delivery owner.
expectations: Routes default values, precedence and validation to Profile Manager and consults its contract/helper or schema
Resolves effective settings before selecting renderers or dependencies
Does not present an editor/delivery document as a second authority for defaults

evals.prompt: Generate a local HTML-only investigation report from saved canonical findings. Markdown and PDF are disabled; nothing will be published. Explain the owning skill, renderer, settings source and checks, without executing commands or querying providers.
evals.expected_output: Investigation Delivery owns the renderer and its local verification, with Profile Manager resolving choices; publication is unnecessary.
expectations: Names Investigation Delivery as owner of local HTML generation and uses skills/investigation-delivery/scripts/generate_html.py with its colocated requirements
Reads effective formats and themes through Profile Manager rather than copied defaults
Requires no Publish It invocation, publication authorization or Markdown/PDF report to generate local HTML
Plans local source/hash receipts, reference QA and visual theme checks; hands packaging to Publish It only if publication is separately authorized

evals.prompt: Deliver the existing investigation-correlation-paths/docs/reports/REPORT-correlation-paths.html using the frozen saved-handoff.json and TASK.md. HTML is enabled/light; PDF and Markdown reports are disabled. All collection is complete: do not run provider.py or query anything live. Update the same canonical HTML with findings, visible evidence-backed metric/state/profile-onset graphs, native stack evidence, source attribution and the saved state/configuration changes. Preserve and make prominent the existing Git ExternalName annotation in the other relevant graphs while adding the verified Service PATCH and later StatefulSet/pod/process events. Use the supplied generic plotting helper or standard plotting tools and the relevant bundled owners. Read back outputs and verify them; retain a delivery receipt recording actual checks and remaining gaps. No publication.
evals.expected_output: Produces and verifies the canonical HTML-only report with the complete correlation handoff, prominent preserved Git/source and actual Kubernetes state changes, profile onset with missing coverage and native stacks, and bounded conclusions.
expectations: Actually updates and reads back the same canonical HTML report; no Markdown/PDF report or publication is created, and effective saved format choices are resolved through Profile Manager

Creates real saved-data graphs and paired light/dark SVG/PNG assets covering CPU/alert states and prior profile intensity/onset, plus representative native-stack flamegraphs through Diagramming Style; a plan/table/Explore link alone does not pass
Plots20% and80% prior loader shares with explicit missing10:15–10:30 coverage, retaining earliest inspected-window and unproven replay/true-onset limits

Preserves a prominent source Git merge10:05 annotation on at least two relevant graph views with Service demo/worker, ExternalName old.example.com→new.example.com, time and E5; does not silently drop it when adding onset/profile views Uses the same descriptive [E5] ExternalName old.example.com→new.example.com event name across those graphs, retaining Git merge as operation context.

Annotates actual Kubernetes Service externalName PATCH10:25 E6 separately from Git merge, and StatefulSet restartedAt PATCH11:30 E4 separately from pod delete/create/process start; conveys restart-consistent payload with exact CLI unknown, without claiming image upgrade

Keeps metric/state data ending11:20 unmeasured after cutoff while representing later lifecycle events on context or companion timelines; never adds post-cutoff Normal/recovery samples or timestamps onto a flamegraph width axis

Includes evidence owner versus actual synthetic collector, source/window/caps and causal gaps consistently in opening, captions/detail and index, preserving tag-versus-digest and empty Slack/history limits
Runs actual artifact/source/theme/reference checks and records their outcomes/gaps in a saved receipt; no claim of full completeness is accepted solely from successful rendering or file existence
Uses the operator-prepared runtime without invoking provider.py, contacting real providers, downloading packages or modifying the user environment during the offline exercise
